definitions.confidentEligibility: Eligible=true and confidence=certain/likely from the deterministic engine for the target country; model-only coverage is separate.
definitions.verifiedAvailability: Same independent availability policy used by job cards (fresh, current, identified posting evidence).
definitions.pendingInference: Discoverable, no current-version inference, needsInference=true and engine returns Remote — region unconfirmed.
definitions.deadLinkShare: Confirmed dead rows divided by all stored rows for that source, including hidden/retired rows.
definitions.unknownAvailability: Discoverable rows without current verified availability; reasons and ATS counts included.
definitions.scope: Freshness, source and closure gates only; no role query or personal skill fit. Each page is read at request time, not a transactionally frozen snapshot.
